memory_candidates: NfCompose (same arity-1 NFs + matching orders implies same arity-r NFs) is FALSE on Prior structures. Counterexample: NfComposition.lean:20-36. (Z, <) pairs (0,2) vs (0,1) have identical 1-var NFs and matching orders but different 2-var NFs due to zone interior differences.

ExistPart_r (parameterized by r parent NF types) is also FALSE for the same reason: two environments with the same parent NF types can have different quantifier conditions if the zone interior structures differ.

The constant-parent constraint in ih_exist (fun _ => t) is a fundamental information gap. It cannot express non-constant environments [y, x, t] where x != t. The zone structure between x and t is NOT determined by individual NF types.

The correct approach for Until/Since backward at k>0 requires zone-explicit temporal formula encoding: decompose exists y, nf_eval [y, x, t] by y's position relative to x and t (5 zones: y>x, t<y<x, y<t, y=x, y=t), and encode each zone using nested temporal connectives with ih_exist at constant parent.
